title: Average treatment effect under unconfoundedness
description: Develop a semiparametric estimator for the ATE from iid observational data with binary treatment, nonlinear outcome regression, and positivity. We want identification, double robustness, asymptotic normality, and practical 95% confidence intervals.

title: Split conformal prediction interval coverage
description: For exchangeable regression data, design a prediction interval procedure with distribution-free marginal coverage and evaluate coverage and interval width under nonlinear data generating processes.

title: Right-censored survival inference at a fixed time
description: For iid time-to-event observations subject to independent right censoring, develop a Kaplan-Meier or Nelson-Aalen survival estimator at a fixed time, state identification, consistency, and Greenwood asymptotic normality goals, and evaluate bias, RMSE, standard error calibration, censoring fraction, and 95% coverage.

title: Robust sub-Gaussian mean inference under contamination
description: For iid observations from a heavy-tailed location model with epsilon-fraction gross-error contamination, develop a median-of-means robust mean estimator, state sub-Gaussian deviation and minimax corruption-rate goals, and evaluate bias, RMSE, standard error calibration, contamination fraction, and 95% coverage.

title: Design-based conservative variance estimation
description: For a randomized experiment with fixed potential outcomes and possible treatment-effect heterogeneity, develop a conservative design-based variance estimator for the difference-in-means treatment effect estimator, state Neyman validity and optimized variance-bound minimality goals, and evaluate bias, RMSE, coverage, SE calibration, and conservativeness ratio.

title: Heteroskedastic robust regression inference
description: For a low-dimensional linear regression with heteroskedastic errors, develop inference for the slope coefficient using sandwich standard errors and evaluate finite-sample Wald interval coverage.

title: False discovery rate control in multiple testing
description: For many independent z-tests with a sparse mixture of non-null effects, develop a multiple testing procedure that controls the false discovery rate while retaining power, and evaluate empirical FDR and discovery power.

title: Anytime-valid sequential Bernoulli testing
description: For sequential Bernoulli observations monitored under optional stopping, develop an e-process based test of H0: p=0.5 with anytime-valid type-I error control and evaluate optional-stopping rejection rate, power, and stopping time.

title: High-dimensional PCA signal-subspace inference
description: For high-dimensional observations from a spiked covariance model with p/n non-negligible, develop a PCA estimator for the leading signal direction, state eigengap and high-dimensional recovery guarantees, and evaluate alignment, angle error, subspace error, and leading eigenvalue behavior.

title: Extreme high-quantile inference with the Hill estimator
description: For iid heavy-tailed observations with a regularly varying upper tail, develop a Hill tail-index estimator and Weissman high-quantile estimator, state consistency and asymptotic normality goals, and evaluate tail-index bias, RMSE, standard error calibration, and high-quantile coverage.
